extracted.intended_audience: prospective and current Magnet Theater improv students (those looking to take intensive courses)
extracted.subtask_description: A schedule and enrollment page listing Magnet Theater's intensive improv offerings (multiple levels and musical improv), showing modality, instructors, dates, times, and any application/approval requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intensives format
rubrics_metrics.description: 6 - 8 weeks worth of class sessions in a single week!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typically only offered during summer and winter break, intensives are a great way to rocket through the Magnet curriculum without missing a beat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Schedule / Daily hours
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each intensive listing shows the daily meeting times and whether it is in-person; start and end dates are provided for each offering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Start and end dates
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every intensive entry lists specific start and end dates (e.g., Starts: June 8th Ends: June 12th), allowing students to plan attendance for the full intensive week.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modality (in-person & online offerings)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the page header advertises both modalities, individual listings indicate modality (most shown here are labeled "in-person").

rubrics_metrics.name: Level-specific offerings and prerequisites
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple levels are offered (e.g., Musical Improv Level One, Improv Level One, Level Two, Level Three, Advanced levels).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some advanced offerings have additional entry requirements—example: "Musical Improv Level Three Intensive (Applications required, rolling approval)" and some entries may require "Instructor Approval."

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructor identification
rubrics_metrics.description: Each intensive lists the instructor (e.g., Michael Lutton, Elana Fishbein, Louis Kornfeld).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructor name is provided beside each course listing to inform students about who will be teaching that intensive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enrollment action / sign-up
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most offerings include a "Sign Up" action; some require "Instructor Approval" or an application process. This indicates how students register and whether additional steps are necessary.
